Sun Data Analytics helps small teams, researchers, creators, and organizations turn messy information into clear reports, dashboards, workflows, and decisions. Current work includes creator analytics, audience and revenue reporting, qualitative transcript coding, title classification, automated report delivery, and public-interest media scraping projects.
